author: Maddie Christianson
text: What app are you using in your iPhone. I’m switching from the Dexcom and it’s not super clear what app I need to download

author: Jenni Graber Smith
text: Great question!!! I had the same problem a while back and when talking with with Customer Service she said “oh they’ve updated their OS again and didn’t let us know” She put me on hold and when she came back she said I should be OK now. At that point I went into my phone settings and turned off the Automatic Updates. I am operating on 17.6.1 because I’m afraid to update anymore.

author: Martine Wijers
text:
Jenni Graber Smith Thank you for your answer!
Today I had contact with the Customer Service as well and they said that this is a very common problem and they try to solve this asap. However, they will send me the reader because for me the alarms are the most important. And without signal it isn’t possible to receive them😕. So I’m waiting for the Reader now, at least it is a temporary good solution🙏🏻.

author: Stephen Sprod
text:
Faulty sensors-blame user for updating their phone. When I lose alarms for more than 2 hours I switch to xDrip. If the sensor is new I’ll call it in to Abbott and when they accuse me of causing this by updating my phone I say “well that isn’t the reason here is it?”  They always replace the sensor
It’s the tiny batteries I think. Sometimes they are so crummy that they won’t even NFC scan.
